description.value: Sushi Howe is a fast-casual Japanese restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, serving a broad menu of poke bowls, nigiri, specialty rolls, ramen, donburi, and bento boxes. The restaurant is vegetarian-friendly and takes online orders, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. Signature items include the Volcano Roll and the Poke Bowl with Howe Special Sauce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates OSM contact details (address 738 Davie St., phone 604-559-8082, email sushihowe@foodly.tech). Active online ordering and a detailed menu confirm the business is open. OSM diet:vegetarian=yes is supported by multiple vegetarian menu items (Edamame, Gomae, Agedashi Tofu, Veggie Sunomono); no bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water-refill information appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Email domain sushihowe@foodly.tech belongs to Foodly Technologies Inc. (the platform operator, per website copyright notice) rather than the restaurant directly — this may not reach the restaurant owner.
